# criblio_search_dataset_rulesets (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_dataset_rulesets" "example" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Ruleset identifier. Use `default` for log dataset rules or `metrics` for metric dataset rules.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered rules for routing events to Datasets. The first matching rule wins. Each rule can include an extend expression to transform matched events.<br/><br/>In the <code>metrics</code> ruleset, the <code>metrics_catchall</code> rule is system-managed: Cribl creates and repairs it. Keep it in the list whenever you replace these rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--items--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rules`

Read-Only:

- `dataset` (String) The <code>id</code> of the target Dataset to route matched events to. Required when <code>sendDataTo</code> is <code>destinationDataset</code>. Ignored when <code>sendDataTo</code> is <code>drop</code>.
- `description` (String) Brief description of the rule.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the rule is ignored for routing.
- `extend_expression` (String) KQL-style extend expression to add or transform fields on matched events.
- `extend_expression_enabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the <code>extendExpression</code> is applied for the rule.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the rule.
- `kusto_expression` (String) Kusto predicate that selects events for this rule.
- `name` (String) Display name of the rule.
- `schema_mapping` (String) Target schema type to map matching events to when <code>schemaMappingMode</code> is <code>add</code> or <code>replace</code>.
- `schema_mapping_mode` (String) How schema mappings are applied when enabled: <code>none</code>, <code>add</code>, or <code>replace</code>.
- `send_data_to` (String) To send matching events to a Dataset, <code>destinationDataset</code>. To drop matching events, <code>drop</code>.
